outcome: maternal morbidity (hysterectomy, blood transfusion, cystotomy, bowel injury, intensive care unit admission, thrombosis, reoperation, or maternal mortality)
cohort: Women with one prior CD and a singleton pregnancy at term who had a repeat CD resulting in live birth.
finding: For women with one prior CD, the morbidity of repeat cesarean after labor is not significantly higher than the morbidity of planned repeat CD.
mod_finding: Patients with repeat cesarean after labor had significantly more 1-minute Apgar scores less than 7, but no difference in 5-minute Apgar scores.
